pull_request.title: Calorimeter: adopt reusable LAr periods in the DD4hep baseline
pull_request.head: codex/lar-placement-default
pull_request.body:
The maintained LAYOUT-002 DD4hep exporter now selects reusable solid inclined-period mothers for the ALLEGRO-style LAr barrel and turbine endcaps. This follows the measured placement investigation in #138 and the user's instruction to update the description. Existing physical solids, materials, poses and readout IDs retain their definitions; standalone exporters retain the legacy controls.

PR #138 is merged. This follow-up targets `main` and includes an ordinary merge of its merged main revision. Review the default-selection and description change here; the underlying factory investigation remains in #138. DES032/DES033 remain DRAFT / PROTOTYPE. Task: `TASK-LAR-PLACEMENT-DEFAULT`; governing contract: `docs/design/inputs/ECAL-baseline-integration-2026-11-04.md`.

The baseline manifest records the observed placement policy and envelope count, and the maintained route rejects missing/unrecognized hierarchies. The design, layout and tool descriptions explain the selected hierarchy and retained validation scope. R–Z drawing inputs preserve the same physical bounds.

Validation performed:

- 39 LAr and 8 baseline controls passed, including maintained-route and missing-hierarchy controls.
- Fresh maintained tracker/ECAL export: systems 0–7/10/11, one barrel and three turbine period templates.
- Removing only four envelope declarations restores the full legacy tracker/ECAL XML; all material bytes match. ECAL XML matches the measured candidate after normalizing only envelope sibling position and indentation.
- Fresh ECAL-only seven-electron probe/readback passed canonical-ID, primary, finite-hit and aimed barrel/wheel/signed-side checks. All 43,648 sensitive and 274,689 terminal-material-leaf inventories match the prior candidate hashes.
- Complete tracker-plus-ECAL native scan passed: all ten systems, 2,079,548 candidates, zero overlaps/extrusions at 10 nm. Exact compact/material/manifest/auditor/library hashes and clean process exit 0 verified.
- Inventory, scientific records, paired sessions, deterministic drawing and token-site checks passed. Verified closed-child counters are recorded; the active parent turn is excluded.

Evidence: `docs/validation/lar-placement-default/README.md` and `results.json`. Full XML, ROOT payloads, dumps and logs remain local and ignored. The prior one-pair serial timing result stays in its original report; this concurrent follow-up smoke supplies no new speedup estimate. Twelve-worker initialization, the 10k response comparison and engineering acceptance remain separate work.


## Accounting and work labels

Work labels: `campaign:calorimeters`, `scope:baseline-design`. Canonical sessions and individual interaction records cover both PRs, including explicit coordinator/SoftEng/PhysVal roles and tool provenance. PR138's post-merge accounting correction is included here.

PR139 has four verified completed child turns: **12,287,858 input, 19,327 output, 12,307,185 total tokens**. The active parent turn remains provisional and is excluded entirely; models/providers remain unknown. Input includes repeated/cached context and is not a cost estimate. Curated recovery: `logs/usage/RECOVERY-2026-11-13-pr138-139.json`.

Independent PhysVal assessments cover the XML/saved-hit evidence at `a630e938` and the completed native-union receipt at `9daf93ad`; no P2-or-higher finding in their bounded scope. Current-head CI remains the final merge-preparation check.

Canonical records: [PR138 interaction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-placement-default/interactions/pr-0138.json), [PR139 interaction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-placement-default/interactions/pr-0139.json), [curated usage recovery](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-placement-default/logs/usage/RECOVERY-2026-11-13-pr138-139.json).
